# Nicholas Velten

> Personal site of Nicholas Velten — full-stack software engineer focused on scalable, well-structured systems. Publishes writing about technology, reading logs and technical learnings.

## About the author

Nicholas Velten is a full-stack software engineer with around four years of professional experience. Currently works at Alloha Fibra, building applications and services with Java, TypeScript, Vue.js and Node.js. Experience spans telecommunications, fintechs and product startups.

Uses Linux with Hyprland, Neovim as editor and Obsidian for personal and technical knowledge management.

Based in Maringá, Paraná, Brazil.

## Available content

- **Writing** (`/posts`): reflections on technology, tools, development and learnings
- **Readings** (`/readings`): reading logs — science fiction, comics and technical books
- **Resume** (`/resume`): professional experience, technical skills and education
- **About** (`/about`): who Nicholas Velten is
- **Amphora** (`/amphora`): personal knowledge management system built on Obsidian and Neovim
- **Mate Creations** (`/matecreations`): theme ecosystem for Neovim, VSCode, Obsidian and Zen Browser
